label: About
title: About Black Lightbox Initiation Room
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 524 recent saved-signal files and 158 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around Anchor image material 3 and Anchor image material 4, plus 7 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Black Lightbox Initiation Room: Blackout gallery installation, architectural section and one-point camera plate: a centered warm landscape lightbox set deep in matte black, floor seams converging from a low foreground. Crisp optical square planes hinge around the panel; a quiet charcoal obstruction partially occludes the grid. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against warm patterned lightbox face, tilted black overhang and square obstruction stack, and left stepped wall aperture glow.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
